annotations.title: Check whether a mailbox's old mail can be copied

description: Say whether this mailbox's old mail can be copied to a new mailbox on our mail servers, from what we already know: no server is dialed, no DNS is read and nothing changes. Copying old mail is open only to our own workspaces for now. It copies a mailbox that reads imappro.zoho.com (Zoho Mail's server for paid plans in the US) to a new mailbox with the same address that our team makes on our mail servers. Our team runs each copy step by hand, so a step starts when someone on our team picks it up; get_mailbox_migration's `next` says who acts now. `offered` is true for a mailbox that connects by SMTP and IMAP in one of our own workspaces, or one our team already made a new mailbox for. `supported` is true when `blockers` is empty, and each blocker is one thing to fix first: `provider_not_supported` (it signs in with Microsoft or Google, or only sends), `source_not_supported` (it doesn't read imappro.zoho.com on port 993 over TLS), `username_not_address` (its login isn't its own address), `not_confirmed` (confirm its address first), `needs_reconnect` (update its logins first), `not_open` (the workspace isn't one of ours), `no_destination` (our team hasn't made its new mailbox yet), `domain_mailbox_cannot_move` (`otherEmail`, another mailbox of this workspace at the same domain, connects through Microsoft, Google or as an agent inbox, so it could never read our servers once the MX record moves), `workspace_suspended` and `workspace_closing`. A key whose read list leaves that other mailbox out gets `otherEmail` null. `adoptable` counts the messages earlier copies already copied and checked, which a new start takes over. `activeMigrationId` names the copy that is running, if one is.
name: preflight_mailbox_migration
title: Check whether a mailbox's old mail can be copied
